title: Houthis fire missiles at Riyadh after Saudi-led strikes on Yemen port
caption:
Saudi Arabia says it intercepted three ballistic missiles fired by Yemen's Houthis at Riyadh early on Saturday, a day after Saudi-led air strikes on Hodeidah port and Sanaa. The Houthis have warned airlines that Saudi airspace is unsafe and threatened Saudi Red Sea ports. The UN says it is deeply concerned about the escalation and that there is no military solution.

One story. Twice a day. Follow for the next edition.
